SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT [b0].[Id], [b0].[Name], [b0].[AreaId], [a].[Name] AS [AreaName], [a].[CityId], [b0].[ProjectType], [b0].[Price], [b0].[Size]
FROM (
    SELECT [b].[Id], [b].[AreaId], [b].[Name], [b].[Price], [b].[ProjectType], [b].[Size]
    FROM [BaseProjects] AS [b]
    ORDER BY [b].[Name], [b].[Id]
    OFFSET @p ROWS FETCH NEXT @p1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [b0]
INNER JOIN [Areas] AS [a] ON [b0].[AreaId] = [a].[Id]
ORDER BY [b0].[Name], [b0].[Id]

SELECT [r0].[Id], [r0].[UnitId], [b].[Number] AS [UnitNumber], [b0].[Name] AS [ProjectName], [r0].[Number], [r0].[Status], [r0].[ReservationDate], [r0].[CancelledAt], [o].[Id] AS [OrderId]
FROM (
    SELECT [r].[Id], [r].[CancelledAt], [r].[Number], [r].[ReservationDate], [r].[Status], [r].[UnitId]
    FROM [Reservations] AS [r]
    ORDER BY [r].[ReservationDate] DESC, [r].[Id]
    OFFSET @p ROWS FETCH NEXT @p1 ROWS ONLY
) AS [r0]
INNER JOIN [BaseUnits] AS [b] ON [r0].[UnitId] = [b].[Id]
INNER JOIN [BaseProjects] AS [b0] ON [b].[ProjectId] = [b0].[Id]
LEFT JOIN [Orders] AS [o] ON [r0].[Id] = [o].[ReservationId]
ORDER BY [r0].[ReservationDate] DESC, [r0].[Id]

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM [Reservations] AS [r]
WHERE [r].[CustomerId] = @_currentUser_CustomerId_Value

SELECT [b0].[Id], [b0].[ProjectId], [b0].[Number], [b0].[MeterPrice], [b0].[FloorNumber], [b0].[Size], CEILING([b0].[Size] * [b0].[MeterPrice] * 100.0) / 100.0 AS [TotalPrice], [i].[NeighborMeterPrice], [i].[Percentage], CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [Reservations] AS [r]
        LEFT JOIN [Orders] AS [o] ON [r].[Id] = [o].[ReservationId]
        WHERE [b0].[Id] = [r].[UnitId] AND [o].[Id] IS NOT NULL AND ([o].[Status] <> 'pending' OR [o].[Status] IS NULL)) THEN CAST(1 AS bit)
    ELSE CAST(0 AS bit)
END AS [IsAvailable]
FROM (
    SELECT [b].[Id], [b].[FloorNumber], [b].[MeterPrice], [b].[Number], [b].[ProjectId], [b].[Size]
    FROM [BaseUnits] AS [b]
    WHERE [b].[ProjectId] = @request_ProjectId
    ORDER BY [b].[Number], [b].[Id]
    OFFSET @p ROWS FETCH NEXT @p2 ROWS ONLY
) AS [b0]
LEFT JOIN [InitiativeUnits] AS [i] ON [b0].[Id] = [i].[UnitId]
ORDER BY [b0].[Number], [b0].[Id]

SELECT TOP(1) [t].[Id], [t].[Title], [t].[Content], [t].[VersionNumber], [t].[EffectiveDate], [t].[IsActive]
FROM [TermsAndConditions] AS [t]
WHERE [t].[IsActive] = CAST(1 AS bit) AND [t].[EffectiveDate] <= @now
ORDER BY [t].[EffectiveDate] DESC, [t].[VersionNumber] DESC

SELECT
      db_id() AS database_id,
      c.system_type_id,
      c.user_type_id,
      c.is_sparse,
      c.is_column_set,
      c.is_filestream,
      c.encryption_type,
      CASE WHEN o.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_user,
      COUNT_BIG(*) AS [ColCount],
      CASE WHEN c.collation_name IS NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(128), SERVERPROPERTY('Collation')) ELSE c.collation_name END AS collation_name,
      AVG(c.max_length) AS avg_max_length
      FROM sys.columns c WITH (NOLOCK)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sys.objects o WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON o.object_id = c.object_id
      AND o.type = 'U'
      GROUP BY
      c.system_type_id,
      c.user_type_id,
      c.is_sparse,
      c.is_column_set,
      c.encryption_type,
      c.is_filestream,
      CASE WHEN o.object_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      CASE WHEN c.collation_name IS NULL THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(128), SERVERPROPERTY('Collation')) ELSE c.collation_name END

SELECT
      db_id() AS database_id,
      o.[type] AS object_type,
      i.[type] AS index_type,
      p.[data_compression],
      COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT p.[object_id]) AS NumTables,
      COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT CAST(p.[object_id] AS VARCHAR(30)) + '|' + CAST(p.[index_id] AS VARCHAR(10))) AS NumIndexes,
      ISNULL(px.[IsPartitioned], 0) AS IsPartitioned,
      IIF(px.[IsPartitioned] = 1, COUNT_BIG(1), 0) NumPartitions,
      SUM(p.[rows]) NumRows
      FROM sys.partitions p
      INNER JOIN sys.objects o
      ON o.[object_id] = p.[object_id]
      INNER JOIN sys.indexes i
      ON i.[object_id] = p.[object_id]
      AND i.[index_id] = p.[index_id]
      OUTER APPLY (SELECT
      x.[object_id], 1 AS [IsPartitioned]
      FROM sys.partitions x
      WHERE x.[object_id] = p.[object_id]
      GROUP by
      x.[object_id]
      HAVING MAX(x.partition_number) > 1) px
      WHERE o.[type] NOT IN ('S', 'IT')
      GROUP BY
      o.[type]
      ,i.[type]
      ,p.[data_compression]
      ,px.[IsPartitioned]
